definitions.explanation: a special envelope with decorative paper strips (noshi) and colored cords (mizuhiki) used for giving money as gifts for celebrations

examples.japanese: のし{袋|ぶくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote my name on the gift envelope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧のし{袋|ぶくろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→ご祝儀：08356_goshuugi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: At weddings, you give congratulatory money in a decorative envelope.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧のし{袋|ぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a gift envelope at the convenience store.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{熨斗|のし}→熨斗：07133_noshi⟧ (decorative paper strip) + {袋|ぶくろ} (bag, envelope)

ELEMENTS:
- ⟦{熨斗|のし}→熨斗：07133_noshi⟧ - decorative folded paper
- ⟦{水引|みずひき}→水引：29258_mizuhiki⟧ - decorative cord
- {表書|おもてが}き - writing on front (occasion name)
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ - giver's name

TYPES:
- ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧ (red and white) - for celebrations
- {黒白|くろしろ} (black and white) - for funerals
- Tied with bowknot (repeatable events) or square knot (one-time events)

OCCASIONS:
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧ - wedding
- ⟦{出産|しゅっさん}→出産：11734_shussan⟧ - birth
- ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧/⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧ - school events
- ⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧ - get-well visits

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→ご祝儀：08356_goshuugi⟧ - congratulatory money
- ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧ - condolence money
- ⟦お{年玉|としだま}→お年玉：08452_otoshidama⟧{袋|ぶくろ} - New Year's money envelope
